_documentation.purpose: S3 lifecycle rules applied to every bucket served by SeaweedFS.
_documentation.format: AWS S3 LifecycleConfiguration expressed as JSON. SeaweedFS loads it via the -s3.lifecycle flag.
_documentation.version_requirement: Requires a SeaweedFS image that supports the -s3.lifecycle flag and JSON-format lifecycle rules (SeaweedFS 3.x, 2024 builds or newer). Older images silently ignore the flag and the rules will not be enforced — verify with `weed version` inside the container.
rules: A) Expire non-current (old) object versions after 90 days.
B) Expire tiny objects smaller than 1 KB after 30 days.
C) Abort incomplete multipart uploads 7 days after initiation.
